▫️

▫️

A smaller wedding doesn’t mean less. It often means more of what matters.

Choosing between a hotel, restaurant, or outdoor venue may seem like a style decision, but in Singapore, it quickly becomes a practical one.
With heat, humidity, and unpredictable rain, each option creates a very different experience for both you and your guests. What feels ideal visually may not always translate comfortably on the day itself.
Here’s what couples should consider when deciding:
▪️
Hotel venues for comfort and controlled environments
▪️
Restaurant weddings for a more intimate atmosphere
▪️
Outdoor venues that depend heavily on weather conditions
▪️
Heat, humidity, and sudden weather changes
▪️
Guest comfort throughout the celebration
The best venue isn’t just the most beautiful one. It’s the one that works for your environment and your experience.

to explore how to choose a venue that balances atmosphere, comfort, and practicality.

All About Si Dian Jin: Is It Still Necessary These Days?
The gifting of Si Dian Jin is a long-standing wedding custom of the Chinese culture that is continuously observed to this day. The term “Si Dian Jin” essentially translates to “Four Touches of Gold,” as it was customarily a four-piece set of betrothal jewellery consisting of a bangle, necklace, ring, and a pair of earrings. This jewellery set is given to the bride as a way of welcoming her into the family and bestowing blessings on the newlyweds.
The origins of the Si Dian Jin custom date back several centuries ago in Guangdong, China. Despite being a centuries-old tradition, the gifting of Si Dian Jin remains an essential practice for many soon-to-be brides and grooms in China, Singapore, and other Asian countries.
